entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
Choosing where to study is about more than a degree – it’s about the life you want to build.
In this video, Indian AUT graduates share why they chose to study in New Zealand and how their time at AUT helped them move confidently into work and life after graduation.
They talk about: 
• Learning that connects directly to real-world work
• Career fairs, employability awards and networking that open doors
• Studying in a place that’s safe, welcoming and proudly multicultural
• Living in Auckland – where the city, beaches and green spaces are all part of everyday life
If you’re thinking about studying abroad and want an education that works beyond the classroom, this is what that journey can look like.

👉 Explore your study options at AUT:
https://www.aut.ac.nz/international/india
